needs.proposedSignature: Face declaration `escalate?: AbilityCost` + covers[].by kind 'escalate' anchored /^escalate(?:[—-] ?| )(.+?)\.?$/ matching the declared cost, AND a `choose-mode` count form `count: 'one-or-more'` (or `{ min: 1, max: 'modes' }`) with a MODE_COSTS hook that charges the escalate cost once per mode beyond the first.
needs.semantics: Escalate is an additional cost paid once per chosen mode beyond the first (Collective Effort's is the non-mana 'Tap an untapped creature you control', so AbilityCost, not ManaCost). It only means anything once choose-mode can express a VARIABLE number of modes: today choose-mode.count is a fixed number, so the parser records 'Choose one or more —' as count: 1 — a silently wrong verdict on a line it claims, not merely a missing declaration. Same family as the existing blocked note for Collective Resistance (bffdfe7b-f17a-41b6-a460-80280fe497d4).
